Ms. Ref. No.: EX-D-26-00001
Title: An invented manuscript
Journal of Examples

Dear Dr. Author,

The reviewers have commented on your paper. Please revise it within 60 days.

Comments from the editors and reviewers:

Reviewer #1: The paper reports a growth assay in shaken flasks.

Major comments
1. The carbon source is called novel without support. Please remove the claim or cite earlier work.
2. Please add:
1. the optical density at inoculation
2. the wavelength
3. The growth rate of 2.5 per day is not credible.
2.5 mM substrate cannot support it.

Minor comments
1. Line 45: "cell-free extract" should be "clarified lysate".
2. Fig. 3 has no scale bar.

Reviewer #2: Comments to the Author
- The flask supplier does not need to be named.
- Please state the antifoam concentration.

Kind regards,
The Editorial Office

In compliance with data protection regulations, you may request that we remove your personal registration details at any time.
